title: Base Editing Protocol for PDCD1, TIGIT, and TRAC in Primary T Cells
author: Jethro Langley

steps.title: Design gRNAs for splice sites
steps.instruction: Use SpliceR to design gRNAs targeting splice donor or acceptor sites for adenine or cytosine base editing; employ the listed gRNA sequences or the AAVS1 mock control sequence.

steps.title: Generate base editor IVT mRNA
steps.instruction: Produce high‑quality IVT mRNA for the base editors following the sequence of actions below.

substeps.instruction: Obtain linear IVT templates: CBE template from Addgene #193843; generate ABE template by replacing the CBE coding region in the same backbone with ABE8e from Addgene #181751.
Amplify and poly(T)-tail the linear templates by PCR using the forward and reverse primers listed above, employing Q5® Hot Start High‑Fidelity DNA Polymerase for 25 cycles.
Verify PCR products by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Purify PCR products with a PCR Cleanup Kit and elute in nuclease‑free water.

Perform in‑vitro transcription with the HiScribe® T7 High Yield RNA Synthesis Kit, substituting UTP with N1‑methyl‑pseudouridine‑5’‑triphosphate and adding a 5’ cap co‑transcriptionally using CleanCap® Reagent AG.
Purify the IVT mRNA using the Monarch® Spin RNA Cleanup Kit and resuspend in 25 µL nuclease‑free water.
Adjust the mRNA concentration to 2 µg/µL, aliquot, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare primary CAR T cells
steps.instruction: Isolate, activate, and lentivirally transduce primary T cells with CAR constructs as described in the referenced “CAR Generation and Preclinical LV Vector Manufacturing” protocol; on day 3 post‑activation wash cells twice with PBS and resuspend at 1 × 10⁶ cells per 100 µL Neon Buffer R.

steps.title: Electroporate T cells with mRNA and gRNA
steps.instruction: For each reaction combine 1 × 10⁶ T cells (in 100 µL Neon Buffer R) with 4.5 µg base‑editor mRNA (ABE mRNA for PDCD1/TIGIT gRNAs; CBE mRNA for TRAC gRNA), 100 pmol of the corresponding gRNA, and 2.5 µL Protector RNase Inhibitor; electroporate using the Neon Transfection System (100 µL tip) at 1600 V, 10 ms pulse width, 3 pulses; immediately transfer cells to pre‑warmed ImmunoCult‑XF medium supplemented with 10 ng/mL IL‑7 and IL‑15.

steps.title: Culture edited T cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the electroporated cells in ImmunoCult‑XF medium containing IL‑7 and IL‑15 at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until analysis.

steps.title: Assess base editing efficiency
steps.instruction: ≥72 h after electroporation evaluate editing by (a) flow cytometry and (b) Sanger sequencing as detailed below.

substeps.instruction: Flow cytometry: stain cells with anti‑PD‑1, anti‑TIGIT, or anti‑TCRα/β antibodies and quantify surface protein knockout.

Sanger sequencing: extract genomic DNA, PCR‑amplify target loci using the listed primer pairs, verify amplicons by agarose gel electrophoresis, purify PCR products with a PCR Cleanup Kit, submit purified DNA for Sanger sequencing (Azenta), and calculate editing frequencies with EditR.
